item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00297","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C25","C23","C05"],"selected_candidate_label":"C25","confidence":0.74,"relationship_type":"structural_functional_template","rationale":"C25 plausibly supplied a material administrative template for the child: both establish a government-wide substantive policy, require implementation within each agency, create a central board to promote uniformity, authorize that board or its leadership to issue rules, advise agencies, coordinate procedures, review disputes or appeals, receive agency information, and report or recommend to the President. The shared machinery is substantially more concrete than a generic committee-creation pattern, although the language is not closely copied. C23 and C05 contain weaker parallels involving government-wide agency duties, central coordination, consultation, reporting, and regulations, but neither matches the child's combined policy-board-review structure as closely.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The following basic policy is established for all Government agencies with respect to inventions hereafter made by any Government employee","parent_excerpt":"All personnel actions taken by Federal appointing officers shall be based solely on merit and fitness","explanation":"Each directive begins by imposing a substantive, government-wide policy on agency personnel administration."},{"child_excerpt":"A Government Patents Board is established ... [and] shall advise and confer with the Chairman ... and suggest modifications or improvements where necessary.","parent_excerpt":"There shall be established in the Civil Service Commission a Fair Employment Board ... [which shall] advise all departments ... coordinate the fair-employment policies and procedures ... [and] make reports and submit recommendations","explanation":"Both create a central board charged with advising agencies, coordinating uniform policy, and recommending improvements."},{"child_excerpt":"The Chairman is authorized and directed ... to formulate and submit to the President for approval such proposed rules and regulations ... [and] to submit annually a report to the President","parent_excerpt":"The Board shall ... make rules and regulations ... [and] make reports and submit recommendations to the Civil Service Commission for transmittal to the President","explanation":"The central body in each directive receives parallel regulatory and presidential-reporting functions."},{"child_excerpt":"To determine with finality any controversies or disputes between any Government agency and its employees ... concerning the ownership of inventions","parent_excerpt":"The Board shall ... review decisions made by the head of any department which are appealed pursuant to the provisions of this order","explanation":"Both use centralized administrative review to resolve employee-agency disputes arising under the new policy."}]}
